source: USGS FDSN Event Web Service 1, API 2.7.0
licenseTerms: USGS-produced data are U.S. public domain; acknowledge U.S. Geological Survey
qualityDefects: The bounded query metadata omits documented metadata.count; consumers must count features.
The unfiltered first 100 contain one explosion among 99 earthquakes.
successCriteria: Produce 1..100 unique rows with required values and three coordinates.
Normalize epoch milliseconds to ISO-8601 UTC Z timestamps.
Two runs from the frozen filtered response are byte-identical.
retention: Raw responses, pipeline, and normalized outputs remain only under /tmp; the AEG repository retains hashes and aggregate evidence, not event rows.
externalConstraints: No personal/sensitive data or API writes.
Do not retain more than 100 records or 1 MB.
Do not publish output without review and attribution.
